characters.name: Yu Gong
characters.source_visual_features: 蓝上衣、深色短裤、浅色胡须，手持长柄工具；古代故事角色。

source_refs.text: Once there was an old man in China. He was 90 years old. His name was Yu Gong. He lived behind two high mountains, Taihang Mountain and Wangwu Mountain. When his family and he wanted to go out, they had to walk a long way around the mountains.

One day, Yu Gong said to his family, “I'm going to remove the two mountains. We must work together.” His wife said, “You are so old, Yu Gong. How can you do that? And where can you throw so many rocks?”
“I can throw them into Bohai Sea,” Yu Gong said.
A man named Zhi Sou laughed at Yu Gong, “You're so old. You can't remove the high mountains!”
“You're wrong,” Yu Gong smiled. “Look, I have sons. My sons have their sons. The family grows. But the mountains can't grow higher.”

source_refs.text: Once upon a time, there was a child called Kong Rong. He had five older brothers and one younger brother. One day, his father bought some pears. He gave the largest one to Kong Rong, but Kong Rong refused and picked the smallest one. "Why?" asked his father. "I'm younger, so I should eat a smaller pear. My older brothers should eat the bigger ones," said Kong Rong. Then his father asked, "What about your younger brother?" Kong Rong said, "I'm older than him. I should take care of him and eat the smallest pear."

Dan and his father walk the old woman home. She lives in a beautiful house. The old woman says, “Thank you. What's your name and address?”
